reviewed_original_first_and_last.prompt: Locked camera, one uninterrupted eight-second shot in the supplied detailed hand-drawn anime style. Begin in the supplied first frame and finish in the supplied last frame. Preserve these two people, their faces, proportions, clothing and hospital waiting-room geometry. For one quiet beat they remain seated apart: he watches her with frightened concern for her, while her gaze stays down-left and away. He makes one careful reach with his right arm behind her shoulder; his visible right hand arrives gently on her outer upper arm, with coherent shoulder, elbow, wrist and finger anatomy. Establish that contact clearly, then he gently draws her torso closer once. Finish by holding the supplied close pose for a quiet beat. Her hands remain passive in her lap throughout, her head stays supported by her own neck, and her gaze remains down-left/away. His head remains self-supported and his concern stays directed toward her. The movement is unhurried, with a continuous visible reach, secure contact, a small torso pull and natural settling. The final closeness remains emotionally unresolved. Show this single action without a cutaway, camera reset, second reach, repeated pull or reversal of who offers support.
reviewed_original_first_and_last.timing_note: Acting guide only, not provider keyframe timing controls or a promised exact result; inspect the actual progression at natural speed.
reviewed_original_first_and_last.requires: Actual uninterrupted motion must independently pass; endpoint eligibility alone is insufficient.

reject_if: Her gaze lifts toward him, she becomes the comforter, or his head is placed in her care
Her hands leave the passive lap position to perform the embrace, or her head loses coherent neck support
His right-arm ownership becomes ambiguous, the hand appears detached, or contact penetrates/slides on her upper arm
Reach takes a high arc over her head, or fingers blur, fuse, multiply, disconnect or teleport
Contact is skipped, the torso moves before contact, or the result only morphs between endpoints
Cutaway, camera reset, discontinuity, second reach, repeated pull, new push or return to separated starting pose
Facial identity, clothing, seat contact or room geometry drifts
Automatic reassurance, reciprocal consolation or emotional recovery replaces the unresolved held aftermath
source_review_constraints: Use exact native 1916×1080 files with recorded hashes; do not silently replace them with storyboard crops or an upscale.
Preserve composition without stretching faces or trimming the visible hand; reconcile the near-16:9 source with output framing during review.
Start fingers partly outside the crop and end upper arm partly occluded; generated transition must establish coherent anatomy and ownership.
Static input approval does not accept the old M01 reach or any new generated middle.
Later hospital returns must preserve the resulting physical closeness or show a motivated change; this pilot does not approve edits to those shots.
